task_brief: Reproduce the public Squidpy spatial-omics workflow using the benchmark-pinned built-in datasets, graph statistics, image features, and structured output contracts.
analysis_focus: load the benchmark-pinned Squidpy built-in datasets and image assets
construct geometry-aware spatial graphs and recover neighborhood, interaction, and autocorrelation outputs
compute image-derived features and relate them back to transcriptomic structure
stage a reproducible submission that a fresh reproducer container can rerun without internet access
success_checks: the workflow respects dataset geometry instead of treating all coordinates identically
ranked Moran and Geary statistic tables are emitted in stable TSV formats with rank, gene, moran_i, and geary_c columns

dataset_manifest.json records datasets.visium_hne_adata.shape, datasets.visium_hne_adata.cluster_labels, datasets.seqfish.shape, and datasets.visium_hne_image.sizes using the benchmark-pinned manifest values
spatial_graph_metrics.json records visium.spatial_neighbors.edges for the benchmark-standard Visium graph
neighborhood outputs include nhood_enrichment_ranked.tsv, centrality_scores.tsv, cooccurrence_curves.tsv, and interaction_matrix.tsv using the benchmark-standard cluster labels
spatial_stats outputs include Ripley L curves, Moran FDR summary counts, and cluster-wise marker localization means

image_features outputs use the benchmark-standard Squidpy recipe: summary, histogram, texture, and watershed segmentation features joined to Visium observations, with feature_summary.json reporting segmentation_feature_count and cluster_counts
interaction outputs use the public custom panel at /workspace/input/paper_bundle/data/ligrec_interactions.tsv when offline OmniPath resources are unavailable
visualization outputs include spatial_stats_plot.svg, marker_localization.svg, and report.html under /workspace/output/agent/visualizations
image-derived outputs are connected back to the observation-level analysis
the built-in dataset manifest at /workspace/input/paper_bundle/data/dataset_manifest.json is referenced when exact public tutorial shapes differ by version
public_data_sources: benchmark-pinned dataset snapshots staged under the paper bundle
reviewer_path: Use the benchmark-pinned offline snapshots under /workspace/input/paper_bundle/data/cache/squidpy_builtin/ and the manifest at /workspace/input/paper_bundle/data/dataset_manifest.json. Load them with explicit Squidpy paths, e.g. sq.datasets.visium_hne_adata(path="/workspace/input/paper_bundle/data/cache/squidpy_builtin/visium_hne_adata.h5ad"), sq.datasets.visium_hne_image(path="/workspace/input/paper_bundle/data/cache/squidpy_builtin/visium_hne_image.tiff"), and sq.datasets.seqfish(path="/workspace/input/paper_bundle/data/cache/squidpy_builtin/seqfish.h5ad"). The sandbox has no network, so if those cache files are absent, document the missing benchmark-prep step instead of attempting live downloads or fabricating outputs.
